lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: geometric design under physical and cost constraints
lessonRef.title: Performance task build: geometric design under physical and cost constraints

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Set up the first two carefully; the rest of the build depends on them.

items.prompt: A solid object has mass 88 g and volume 11 cm³. Find its density, and state whether it would float in water (density 1 g/cm³).
A square patio of side 16 m is to be paved at $20 per square metre. Find the total cost, and state which quantity the cost is proportional to.
choices: $5120; the cost is proportional to the area
$1280; the cost is proportional to the perimeter
$320; the cost is proportional to the area
$5120; the cost is proportional to the side length

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Find the volume of a cone of radius 7 and height 5. Leave π in the answer where it appears.
Describe the cross-section formed by a cylinder cut by a plane perpendicular to its base through the axis.
A solid object has mass 30 g and volume 5 cm³. Find its density, and state whether it would float in water (density 1 g/cm³).
A square patio of side 9 m is to be paved at $7 per square metre. Find the total cost, and state which quantity the cost is proportional to.
choices: $567; the cost is proportional to the side length
$63; the cost is proportional to the area
$567; the cost is proportional to the area
$252; the cost is proportional to the perimeter

items.prompt: Find the volume of a cylinder of radius 9 and height 7. Leave π in the answer where it appears.
Describe the cross-section formed by a sphere cut by any plane that meets it in more than one point.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Carry the build to a result and state the check that would catch an error in it.

items.prompt: A solid object has mass 140 g and volume 20 cm³. Find its density, and state whether it would float in water (density 1 g/cm³).
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A square patio of side 19 m is to be paved at $14 per square metre. Find the total cost, and state which quantity the cost is proportional to.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
